industry_context.name: 汽車服務系統
industry_context.headline: 汽車維修營運中心：先診斷等待根因，再管理接車到交車
industry_context.audience: 三間汽車保養維修廠的主管、服務顧問、技師與車主。

palette_roles.brand: primary identity and first visual impression
palette_roles.accent: interactive highlights, cards, and secondary emphasis
palette_roles.highlight: CTA, badges, important numbers, and proof points
palette_roles.surface: dark readable background to keep Traditional Chinese copy clear

visual_strategy.contrast_rule: Use dark translucent overlays behind Traditional Chinese text; keep primary CTAs on highlight color and avoid low-contrast text over busy images.
visual_strategy.responsive_rule: Use clamp(), balanced wrapping, and overflow wrapping so long Chinese titles do not clip on mobile.

delivery.marketing_h1: 汽車服務系統：把複雜需求整理成可理解、可操作的服務
delivery.pricing_h1: 汽車服務系統服務方案：先看懂適合誰、能做什麼、需要注意什麼
delivery.pricing_lead: 汽車服務系統網站必須用一般使用者聽得懂的文字說明用途、資料或流程邊界、使用方式與重要提醒，並避免把不必要的技術細節放到公開頁面。
delivery.stage1_title: 汽車服務系統基礎查詢
delivery.stage1_body: 整理汽車服務系統常見問題、分類、條件與結果說明，讓使用者能先用自然語言查詢與比較。
delivery.stage2_title: 汽車服務系統互動服務
delivery.stage2_body: 依汽車服務系統場景呈現表單、卡片、流程、圖片素材與提醒，讓使用者知道下一步怎麼做。
delivery.stage3_title: 汽車服務系統進階確認
delivery.stage3_body: 涉及預約、下單、付款、申請、上傳或公開資料時，先顯示摘要、來源與限制，再由使用者確認。

industry_context.image_guidance: 車輛照片、試駕圖、維修流程圖、規格比較圖。

home.title_source: project.yaml owner_goal + app-home-copy.md + project stage catalog when the product has one
content_source: planned downstream boundaries when required by the product
home.content_rule: Must frame the whole project first: the project's Stage 1 plugin/MCP delivery, Stage 2 website/backend continuation, and any later login/payment/submission/operations boundaries that this project actually needs. Do not force the developer-assistant six-stage commercial model onto unrelated industries. Never make the homepage only about Stage 2 validation or reuse generic query-tool copy.

marketing.content_rule: Must show what the developer receives at each stage and what is not yet proven.

pricing.content_rule: For 開發助手 self-build, must preserve NT$1,200 / 800 / 500 / 700 / 400 and total NT$3,600 unless catalog changes.

guide.content_rule: Must tell users what to say and what the system will read; users should not need to name internal tools.

templates.content_rule: Must explain industry-specific layout/component choices; template selection is fallback, not default.

assets.content_rule: Must distinguish R2 files, Cloudflare Images transformations, website render URLs, and ChatGPT UI render evidence.

connect.title_source: stage2_connector_onboarding_registry + owner authorization and provider boundary
connect.content_rule: Must distinguish three audiences: the assistant-core website teaches industry developers how to connect 開發助手 in ChatGPT; after Stage 1 it teaches developers how to connect their own generated plugin using their own MCP/server URL; future generated industry websites teach the developer's end users how to connect that specific plugin. Owner authorization is required, password/OTP/secret copy-paste is forbidden, and no page may imply OpenAI/ChatGPT review approval is guaranteed.

docs.content_rule: Must prove Stage 2 consumed Stage 1 context; never copy another product's docs.

status.content_rule: Must separate local, GitHub, Render, MCP, ChatGPT native, submission, and approval evidence.

privacy.content_rule: Must explain data use and retention without exposing raw chat logs or internal prompts.

terms.content_rule: Must explain what the service can and cannot promise at each stage.

support.content_rule: Must guide users to provide evidence without asking for passwords, OTP, tokens, or secrets.

admin.content_rule: Admin UI can preview read models in Stage 2; real writes require owner-gated backend authorization.

hero_system.design_standard: 第一眼要說清楚服務對象、核心價值與下一步；背景與標題要有產業感，不能只換顏色。

structured_card_grid.design_standard: 把服務、證據、元件或方案拆成易讀卡片；桌機可有層次，手機必須單欄可讀。

status_and_evidence.design_standard: 把驗證、完成狀態、限制與下一步翻成台灣使用者看得懂的中文，不外露工程狀態碼。

conversion_cta.design_standard: 按鈕必須連到真實頁面、表單或明確標示的預覽動作，不可只有動畫或 console.log。

motion_background.design_standard: 背景、光暈、波紋、星空、3D 深度或線條只能輔助內容；不得使用持續旋轉背景，需支援 reduced motion，不能讓文字消失。

text_emphasis.design_standard: 可用打字、翻轉、highlight 強化主張，但完整文案必須靜態可讀。

process_timeline.design_standard: 用流程、時間線或追蹤線說明階段交付、驗證與使用步驟。

pricing_experience.design_standard: 價格、階段、交付物與不能承諾的事要放在同一脈絡；不得只做漂亮價格卡。

asset_and_upload.design_standard: 要分清楚本機素材、R2、Cloudflare Images、公開 URL 與 ChatGPT UI 可渲染證據。

authorization_and_provider.design_standard: Google/GitHub/Render/Cloudflare 等需要本人授權的地方，要顯示中文下一步與邊界。

policy_and_boundary.design_standard: 隱私、條款、支援與資料邊界要用一般中文說明，避免內部提示詞或原始紀錄外露。

admin_operations.design_standard: 後台可以保留系統真相，但畫面要用中文摘要、中文狀態與可操作的下一步呈現。

home.content_rule: Must frame the whole project first: the project's Stage 1 plugin/MCP delivery, Stage 2 website/backend continuation, and any later login/payment/submission/operations boundaries that this project actually needs. Do not force the developer-assistant six-stage commercial model onto unrelated industries. Never make the homepage only about Stage 2 validation or reuse generic query-tool copy.

design_element_registry.future_database_policy: May be promoted to a tenant-safe database later, but public site generation must not depend on mutable cross-project records.
design_element_registry.selection_rule: Select by page role, project context, marketing goal, accessibility, motion comfort, license boundary, then visible marker validation.
design_element_registry.agent_policy: Use existing Stage 2 orchestrators and gates first. Create a separate agent only if multi-pass visual repair cannot be composed from deterministic tools and skills.

elements.solves: 讓複雜流程像企劃書與設計稿一樣好閱讀，避免深色科技模板疲勞。
把下一步、狀態切換與重要階段用一致品牌色標出來。
避免置中 SaaS 模板感，讓首頁第一眼有品牌記憶點與閱讀動線。
把工具、階段、證據與交付物變成可視化的產品工程圖，不只用文字堆疊。
分清楚本機、GitHub、部署、MCP、原生測試與送審，不再用一句完成混充。
讓免費評估與第一到第六階段各自有位置，避免首頁只講第二階段。
用 reveal、hover、marquee 與按壓回饋提示互動，不使用讓人暈的旋轉背景。

ui_component_selection_evidence.public_label: UI/UX 候選元件已依頁面目的、產業情境、授權、動態舒適度與正式 Next.js/React/Tailwind 架構進行規劃。
ui_component_selection_evidence.truth_boundary: Public summary only. Detailed component names, third-party source names, forbidden demo strings, and internal selection reasons stay in the internal manifest and validation files.

status_copy_map.public_non_sensitive_read_model: 目前顯示安全公開資料
status_copy_map.OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED: 需要管理者授權後才能修改
status_copy_map.OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED_WITH_NEXT_A: 需要管理者授權，並依畫面下一步繼續

stage2_ui_recipe_auto_map.marketing_goal_rule: Classify the marketing goal before selecting UI: trust, conversion, showcase, education, comparison, booking, transaction, upload, or admin operations.
stage2_ui_recipe_auto_map.user_guidance_rule: Every selected UI pattern must help a first-time visitor quickly understand what the site does, who it is for, what to click next, what status means, and what still requires confirmation.
stage2_ui_recipe_auto_map.selection_rule: Match marketing goal and page role first, then industry priority, then stack/license compatibility, then visible-marker validation.
stage2_ui_recipe_auto_map.beauty_rule: 美觀不是只換色；必須同時檢查背景質感、資訊層次、舒適互動節奏、手機閱讀與中文可理解性；不得選用讓人不舒服的持續旋轉背景。
stage2_ui_recipe_auto_map.motion_safety_rule: Do not auto-select rotating background UI. Prefer non-rotating 3D depth, static layered glow, low-contrast grids, cursor-responsive cards, hover-only cards, or reduced-motion friendly reveals.

stage2_ui_visible_strengthening.public_label: 第二階段會在產出後再分析一次首頁、方案、文件、後台、串接與素材頁，讓全部 UI 候選都有可運用場景、觸發條件與安全替代，而不是只停留在候選清單。
quality_gates: 全部 UI 候選都有頁面或情境對應
首頁、方案、文件、後台、串接、素材頁都有可見 UI 區塊
旋轉眩暈類不得預設啟用
深色區塊不得使用低對比文字
不得把開發助手本體內容污染到其他產業網站
stage2_ui_visible_strengthening.truth_boundary: Public summary only. Full component mapping stays in internal manifest and validation reports.

stage2_ui_source_registry.public_label: 第二階段已納入前端設計資源庫，會依頁面目的、品牌調性、授權可用性、效能與動態舒適度選用。
quality_gates: 只抽取可合法使用的方法與互動模式
不公開完整元件清單與授權風險細節
不複製第三方示範品牌或文案
商用風險留在管理者證據與交接資料
stage2_ui_source_registry.truth_boundary: Public source summary only. Exact source names, component imports, license files, hashes, commercial-risk notes, and build evidence stay in internal manifests/admin evidence.

stage2_full_stack_resource_registry.ui_source_public_label: 已納入多個前端設計資源，完整來源、授權與商用風險檢查留在內部證據。
stage2_full_stack_resource_registry.selection_rule: Reuse existing project stack when safe; otherwise Stage 2 generated production website target is Next.js/React/TypeScript/Tailwind with a coexisting FastAPI scaffold. The selector decides responsibility split: Next.js Server for website/simple routes; FastAPI for MCP/Python/data/webhook/auth/payment/operations backends. PostgreSQL is added only when production data scale, paid users, or tenant isolation require it.
stage2_full_stack_resource_registry.truth_boundary: Public framework summary only. Concrete dependency installation, migrations, provider credentials, and runtime evidence stay in internal validation.

stage2_design_element_registry.future_database_policy: May be promoted to a tenant-safe database later, but public site generation must not depend on mutable cross-project records.

stage2_design_element_registry.agent_policy: Use existing Stage 2 orchestrators and gates first. Create a separate agent only if multi-pass visual repair cannot be composed from deterministic tools and skills.

stage2_design_thinking_registry.public_label: 第二階段設計前會先檢查色彩對比、視覺層級、品牌色角色、行銷目標、行動按鈕、動效舒適度與防污染清單。
quality_gates: 文字背景對比
首屏動線
行動按鈕清楚
動效舒適
不複製第三方品牌或範例內容
stage2_design_thinking_registry.truth_boundary: Public summary only. Full design source notes and internal validation details stay in internal evidence files.

stage2_policy_page_registry.public_label: 第二階段會產生隱私權政策、使用條款、客服與資料邊界頁，並檢查資料用途、第三方授權、保存刪除、使用者確認與不得保證審查通過。
quality_gates: 隱私欄位完整
條款邊界完整
第三方授權清楚
保存與刪除清楚
不複製其他外掛品牌或條文
stage2_policy_page_registry.truth_boundary: Public summary only. Owner still needs to review legal accuracy and submit reachable policy URLs in the official platform UI.

stage2_connector_onboarding_registry.public_label: 第二階段會產生 ChatGPT 外掛連接教學，區分網站擁有者、開發者與使用者的授權步驟，並檢查不得要求密碼、驗證碼或私密金鑰。
quality_gates: 連接教學角色清楚
第一階段外掛連結可接續
終端使用者看得懂如何連接
授權安全說明完整
不保證平台審查通過
stage2_connector_onboarding_registry.truth_boundary: Public summary only. Live ChatGPT connection, platform review, and provider authorization require separate evidence.

stage_usage_guide_sync_contract.purpose: 當階段能力、工具或技能新增/修改時，自動同步使用教學、客服知識庫、素材頁、串接頁、測試文件、狀態頁與後台說明。
stage_usage_guide_sync_contract.guard_rule: 能力存在但使用說明未同步時不得宣稱完成；公開教學只講使用方式，不列出內部工具矩陣、完整 UI 候選清單或商用授權細節。

stage2_reference_experience.rule: Use external AI-built website cases only as technical-process lessons. Do not depend on Manus or copy external brands, demo content, or unclear-license UI source.

industry_project_forbidden_examples: developer assistant pricing or commercial logic
third-party demo brands or placeholder people
internal tool names, private prompts, secrets, tokens, or raw chat transcript
cross_stage_pollution_guard.rule: Generated public pages and delivery packages must use only this project's sanitized content sources. Factory self-build wording is allowed only when current_project_identity.industry is developer_tooling.

deployment_handoff.expected_free_url_kind: reachable HTTPS website URL after deployment
deployment_handoff.not_a_live_url_until: A provider returns a reachable website URL and validation records frontend_url_verified=true.

portable_design_package.purpose: 讓開發者除了線上網址，也能下載完整網站設計與建置包，交給其他 AI、工程師或設計師延伸，不必重新描述需求。
required_contents: frontend_site/：首頁、方案頁、文件頁、狀態頁、素材頁、授權頁與後台預覽
frontend_site/public/assets/：Logo、背景圖、主視覺、社群圖與素材清單
frontend_site/site-manifest.json：頁面、導覽、UI recipe、SEO、素材與部署規則
frontend/content/：由第一階段專案檔與對話決策 trace 產生的網站文案來源
stage2_delivery/：API 摘要、驗證矩陣、部署契約、圖片策略與能力來源台帳
website_architecture/：第一階段到第二階段銜接契約
validation/：本地檢查、內容守門、UI recipe 對應與交付驗證報告
README-for-next-ai.md：給其他 AI 或工程師讀的中文接續說明、不得出現的內容與授權邊界
portable_design_package.validation_rule: 壓縮檔不是只放 HTML；必須包含內容來源、UI/UX 對應、素材替換槽、部署邊界與測試證據。

design_import_boundary.figma: optional owner-authorized design reference import; not required for local static generation
design_import_boundary.canva: optional owner-authorized brand asset/template reference import; not required for local static generation
design_import_boundary.build_web_apps: optional external builder reference; generated code must still pass project guards before registration

image_variants.industry_background: decorative SVG/WEBP/PNG background matched to the website domain

website_asset_pipeline.developer_upload_intake: Use file_upload_pipeline_builder when a site needs user-uploaded product, property, menu, logo, case-study, background, or marketing images.

image_generation_guidance.default_mode: Generate safe local SVG examples from the industry profile so every template has a visible industry background before paid image generation.
image_generation_guidance.optional_ai_image_mode: If the developer wants AI-generated photos or illustrations, guide them to use their own authorized ChatGPT image generation, Canva, Figma, or storage provider account; record source, consent, replacement path, and cost boundary.

website_asset_pipeline.public_url_rule: Local files are not public URLs. A public image URL exists only after owner-authorized deployment or storage provider upload returns a reachable HTTPS URL.
website_asset_pipeline.security_boundary: Do not publish private, unlicensed, personal, medical, financial, or customer images without owner consent and project policy.

must_prevent: buttons that are too small to tap
responsive_guard.truth_boundary: CSS/static checks only; real device visual QA or browser screenshots are separate evidence.

public_content_boundary.source_rule: Only public-facing product copy, sanitized feature summaries, delivery status, and owner-action guidance may appear on website pages.
must_not_publish: anger/profanity or complaint wording from tests
private prompts or internal handoff instructions
commercial pricing formulas or private packaging logic
secret names, token examples, OTP/password requests
implementation-only tool IDs unless shown inside developer documentation, not marketing copy
internal R2/manifest/key/signed URL/proxy proof phrases on visitor-facing guide pages
public_content_boundary.sanitization_rule: Translate internal development evidence into friendly product outcomes before writing frontend pages.
public_content_boundary.runtime_api_rendering_rule: API JSON may keep machine-readable status codes, but public/admin HTML must render them as plain Traditional Chinese labels.

product_site_flow.process_reference: Use mature product-site process patterns only; do not copy any existing customer brand, data, code, private prompts, or production configuration.
product_site_flow.wordpress_reference_abstraction: Use template parts, page patterns, style variations, and responsive image planning as neutral website-builder architecture, not as a WordPress dependency.
product_site_flow.commerce_reference_abstraction: Use cart/checkout blocks and Store API concepts as neutral transaction architecture: client UI, server-side cart truth, checkout tokens, order snapshot, and payment boundary.
product_site_flow.quality_rule: Developer-facing pages must explain outcomes, next actions, and truth boundaries in plain language instead of exposing internal tool names.

template_architecture.source_reference: WordPress Theme Handbook template hierarchy abstraction; no WordPress runtime or copied theme code.
template_architecture.fallback_rule: If a domain-specific page label or content block is missing, fall back to the generic profile but still require visible industry keywords before validation can pass.

seo_readiness.source_reference: Google Search Central abstraction for crawlable, understandable, user-visible content.
seo_readiness.truth_boundary: Local static SEO tags and files are generated; Google indexing, Search Console verification, ranking, rich results, and public crawl proof require deployed URLs and owner authorization.

public_manifest_boundary.rule: Files inside frontend_site/public must not expose local account paths, raw project slugs, private handoff text, or implementation-only provider names.

truth_boundary: Frontend site builder creates a deployable static website preview fallback, local assets, and local validation proof only. The Stage 2 production website/frontend target for generated plugin/SaaS products is Next.js App Router + React + TypeScript + Tailwind. A public website URL, public image URL, connector validation, platform review, or approval requires the project owner to complete the related provider authorization and must be verified with reachable live evidence.

base_package.label: 資料查詢與營運基礎套件
base_package.purpose: 讓條件、結果、來源、狀態與管理資料容易核對。

project_aware_stage_2.template_policy: Project-aware generation is the default; template selection is an optional fallback.
